title: Edmund Charles Yonge
dates: (11 Aug 1827-12 or 15 Jan 1847)
---

cousin of CMY

Known as Charles Yonge, he was the fifth son of Rev John Yonge of Puslinch and Alethea Bargus, CMY describes him as \'born on my birthday in 1827\' [a tablet in Newton Ferrars church says \'d.

Jan 15 1847 aged 19 years\']
